grants.basis: Establishes a Geneva financing-support source; eligibility is programme- and case-specific.

aml.title: FINMA: AML legal framework
aml.basis: Establishes relevant Swiss source layers; does not establish that every fiduciary mandate is subject to them.

uid.basis: Shows punctuated and compact CHE identifiers. Used only to assess identity-format handling, not to add a VAT workflow.

restructuring.basis: Historical directive: supports existence of local restructuring work only. Not relied on as a complete current procedural rulebook.
